title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.22995v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grained and still treats agent exploration as isolated, linear trajectories. This oversimplified perspective ignores the inherent graph structure of state transitions, leading to high-variance state-value estimation and myopic, localized credit assignment. translated_title: 面向长时程智能体强化学习的群组-图策略优化
translated_abstract: 基于分组的强化学习已在智能体场景中显著增强了大语言模型（LLMs）的能力。为了实现更细粒度的策略更新，近期的智能体强化学习框架已从轨迹级训练转向步骤级训练。然而，长时程智能体强化学习面临着严重的奖励稀疏与延迟问题，因为反馈往往要推迟数十个交互步骤之后才会出现。尽管现有的步骤级框架细化了训练粒度，但其信用分配仍然是粗粒度的，并且依然将智能体的探索视为孤立的线性轨迹。这种过于简化的视角忽略了状态转换中固有的图结构，导致了高方差的状态价值估计以及短视的、局部化的信用分配。为了克服这些关键瓶颈，我们提出了群组-图策略优化（G2PO），这是一种专为多轮智能体任务量身定制的新型分组强化学习算法。G2PO 显式地将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出群组-图策略优化（G2PO），一种针对多轮智能体任务的新型分组强化学习算法，通过显式利用状态转换固有的图结构，解决了长时程智能体强化学习中奖励稀疏延迟、高方差价值估计以及短视局部化信用分配的关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: G2PO, a novel group-based reinforcement learning algorithm for multi-turn agentic tasks, explicitly exploits the inherent graph structure of state transitions to overcome key bottlenecks in long-horizon agentic RL, including reward sparsity and delay, high-variance value estimation, and myopic credit assignment.
